user_saw: The IRC bot replied in a channel with an explicitly empty sender list when the wildcard configuration allowed the sender.
summary: The fix treats an explicitly empty IRC channel sender list as a deny-all override of wildcard and global sender permissions.
reasoning: The July 1 snapshot already checks `groupMatch.groupConfig?.allowFrom?.length`, which makes an empty channel list fall through to the wildcard list. The later refactor moved that logic from `inbound.ts` to `monitor.ts` unchanged. The offline path history stopped at a missing commit object, so I could not establish when the fallback was introduced or whether an earlier version honored empty lists.
